newsitem.title: IRAN: Quake-hit Iran appeals for 100,000 tonnes barley.
newsitem.headline: Quake-hit Iran appeals for 100,000 tonnes barley.

text.p: Iran has appealed for 100,000 tonnes of barley to immediately feed 200,000 head of livestock in the quake-stricken northwest.

Iran also wants 70 tonnes of wheat seed and 70 tonnes of barley seed immediately, according to a list of the country's needs issued on behalf of the Islamic republic by the United Nations following Friday's earthquake, which left almost 1,000 people dead.
In a statement, the United Nations said: "In order to increase the effectiveness and speed of international assistance, the government would prefer local purchases where possible."
The list indicated that the barley, as well as the grain seeds, was locally available.

It said immediate and intermediate food requirements for 60,000 affected people for the next four months included 1,320 tonnes of rice, 440 tonnes of unspecified grains and 440 tonnes of sugar. It indicated that all were available locally.
The earthquake, which completely destroyed 20 villages and damaged 80 others in the agricultural province of Ardabil, measured 5.5 on the Richter scale.
About 30,000 head of livestock perished in the quake.
